packageRules.description: sha1 and md-5 share the digest traits: hash.rs applies sha1::Digest to Md5, so whichever arrives first does not compile against the other. They move together or not at all.
ratatui pins the crossterm its backend speaks. Separate updates leave two crossterm versions in the tree, one for our own raw mode and key events and one behind the backend.

reqwest is not used by rompom: it is declared to pin the version screenscraper and internetarchive resolve. Moving it alone adds a second HTTP and TLS stack to the binary instead of upgrading anything, so it follows the two libs. Patch updates within the line they use are still welcome.
